## What Kind of Issue Is This?

<!-- Mark one with an x. -->

- [ ] **Content error:** text, a table, a callout or a code sample is wrong
- [ ] **Outdated content:** GitHub or the exam has changed since this was written
- [ ] **Site bug:** search, navigation, a broken link or accessibility
- [ ] **Device issue:** the site looks or behaves wrong on a specific device, screen size or browser
- [ ] **Other:** something else, or a suggestion to make the notes clearer

## Where?

<!-- Paste a link to the page or section. Click the section in "On This Page", then copy the address bar. -->

## What Is Wrong?

<!-- Quote what the notes say, or describe what happened and the steps that led to it. Screenshots help, especially for device issues. -->

## What Should It Be?

<!-- Give the correct information, or what you expected to happen. -->

## Official Source

<!-- For content issues, link to the page that supports this, such as GitHub Docs (https://docs.github.com/en) or the study guide (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/resources/study-guides/gh-900). -->

## Browser and Device

<!-- For site bugs and device issues only. Include the device, operating system, browser and, if it matters, the orientation. For example: Safari on iPhone 15, iOS 18, portrait. -->
